## [1.7.0](https://github.com/bartlomiejfornalczyk/morphe-patches/compare/v1.6.1...v1.7.0) (2026-09-28)

### ✨ New Features

* **maps:** replace exact package matching with endsWith for flawless media integration ([50fee39](https://github.com/bartlomiejfornalczyk/morphe-patches/commit/50fee39731d118fd16a2a4a218d6ce581fdf2f7e))

patches.name: Allow Morphe YouTube Music mini player
patches.description: Enables YouTube Music and modded media apps as the navigation mini player.

options.description: Package name of your modded YouTube Music app.

patches.name: Allow Morphe YouTube Music package visibility
patches.description: Adds package queries and permission to AndroidManifest.xml for full media apps visibility.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs alongside stock Google Maps under its own package name and adds MicroG spoofing.

options.description: The package name to install under.

patches.name: Flexible Media App Match
patches.description: Allows Google Maps to connect to renamed media apps by checking if the package name ends with the expected string rather than an exact match.

patches.name: Restore map data
patches.description: Lets a re-signed Maps load tiles, search and routing, by sending Google's own package and certificate.
